summary: Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $4.25 billion unsecured five-year revolving credit facility dated June 2, 2026, replacing a prior $3.5 billion facility. The facility, with Citibank as administrative agent, bears interest based on Term SOFR plus a margin tied to credit ratings and matures in June 2031. It includes quarterly maintenance covenants on coverage and leverage ratios. This is a routine refinancing of corporate credit lines, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category applies.
